t: Universal sealant and adhesive with hybrid technology. Free of isocyanates, solvents and silicones, whilst resistant to UV, moisture and weather. Does not crack, shrink or bubble and is non-corrosive towards metals. Neutral curing, almost odourless and adheres perfectly without a primer on most surfaces. Absorbs acoustic and mechanical vibrations. Remains flexible and is paintable once fully cured. Suitable for interior and exterior applications.
b: Can be Used on Damp Surfaces
